name: io.github.icedq-tools/mcp-server
description: MCP Server for iceDQ Data Reliability Platform

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL of your iceDQ instance (e.g., https://app.icedq.net)

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_REALM
environmentVariables.description: The authentication realm name (e.g., icedq or iam.icedq)

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID for API authentication

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: How to authenticate: 'username_password' uses credentials below, 'access_token' uses a token file instead

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret. Required when AUTH_TYPE is 'username_password'.

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your iceDQ username. Required when AUTH_TYPE is 'username_password'.

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your iceDQ password. Required when AUTH_TYPE is 'username_password'.

environmentVariables.name: TOKENS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to JSON file containing access_token and refresh_token. Required when AUTH_TYPE is 'access_token'.

environmentVariables.name: ICEDQ_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your iceDQ organization ID (e.g., org-icedq or org-iam.icedq)

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Enable SSL certificate verification. Set to false only for self-signed certs in testing.

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for API requests, in seconds
